changes.title: Pixel snap
items: The pixel art is crisper on screens scaled to 125% or 150%: every pixel is now the same size, not some a quarter narrower than the next
Half as much blur at the top and bottom of the screen

changes.title: Bold sigils all
items: Every creature's sigil in your stack, over the stones and on the pointers is now bold: thick strokes and the one feature you can't miss (antlers, ears, tusks, wings, a shell), so you can tell them apart at a glance

changes.title: Fight styles
items: Fights move more: each kind has its own way of fighting. Chargers thunder past and wheel round for another pass, wolves and their like circle you, foxes and cats flank you, hares and toads bound in big hops
Between attacks, a pack spreads out wide round you, each animal at its own spot, instead of bunching up
Your animals spread out round whatever they're fighting instead of piling onto one spot
Your 💌s home in on where a running creature is going, so the quick ones are easier to hit
